## Test evidence

- [ ] `npm test` passes locally
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has an automated test
- [ ] Manual check recorded in `docs/06_Test_Cases.csv`

## Review checklist

- [ ] The author did not approve their own pull request
- [ ] A non-author reviewer checked the acceptance criteria
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` values or local database files are included
- [ ] README or CHANGELOG updated when behaviour or setup changed

## Reviewer notes

Record the decision, requested changes and any known limitation.
